sourcesContent:
app TypedOperationForms
Given
 Entry { label:text label="Entry label", count:int=1 label="Count", owner:user server=actor }
 policy Entry read=members
When
 crud Entry by=members fields=label,count label={create="Create entry"}
 ## The bound entry keeps its admitted version; only label and delta are editable.
 scenario rename(entry:Entry label="Entry",newLabel:text label="New label",delta:int=1 label="Increment") -> int by=members label="Rename entry"
  do
   set entry {label=newLabel,count=entry.count+delta}
   return entry.count
Then
 page / title="Canonical forms"
  require members
  ## Required writable inputs appear once, and the managed owner has no widget.
  form Entry.create display=inline submit="Add entry"
   input label
   input count
  ## Same-operation occurrences keep independent field identities, drafts and nonces.
  form Entry.create display=inline submit="Add another entry"
   input label
   input count
  list Entry empty="No entries"
   text row.label
   form rename arguments={entry=row} fields=newLabel,delta display=inline submit="Save changes"
    input newLabel
    input delta
